Billboard Hot 100, number-one singles. Currently from 1984 onwards.

Slowly adding missing tracks/years. The aim is for this playlist to cover the entire decade.

All the tracks in this playlist are linked to verified videos, which should remain up on YouTube, providing a form of permanence so there aren't missing songs due to takedowns. A consequence is that some tracks are not linked to their original videos - instead live, yet verified, performances.
